    # Reverse direction when reaching angular limits near ±π/2

        direction = -1
    elif current_angle <= -math.pi / 2 + 0.1:

    sandbox.add_joint(connecting_rod, slider, (slider_x_center, slider_y_center), type='pivot')

    return {"motors": [crank_joint]}
